Some additional data was collected by a custom application that watched the
streaming Twitter API, in accordance with Twitter's Developer Agreement &
Policy. This software gives statistics about words that were commonly used on
Twitter; it does not display or republish any Twitter content, and does not
contain any content from after Twitter's sale.

selection.order: Descending upstream frequency bins; upstream alphabetical order within ties.
selection.definition: First 500 eligible lowercase ASCII alphabetic tokens, allowing internal apostrophes. Excludes digit placeholders, punctuation, accented spellings and other scripts; retains contractions, single letters, names and informal/offensive words when ranked. No manual word substitutions.

baseline.description: Observed legacy one-phone-per-group importer and cue policy version 2, before richer import and UFLI AH0 supplement; captured in this session before edits.

edgeChecks: hello AH0 is ə with sourced quick cue
box x retains K quick + S stretch
make retains silent e and split-a-e teaching unit
limits: This is the first 500 eligible tokens in the pinned wordfreq English large list; not a universal top-500 list, a reading curriculum, or a child-frequency corpus.
CMUdict primary pronunciation is selected without context; numbered alternatives include dialect and reduction variants as well as heteronyms.
Mapped means the source spelling and phoneme sequence pass importer checks. It does not certify every grapheme choice as suitable teaching material.
Complete teaching cues means every selected phone has documented quick/stretch evidence; missing cue evidence does not mean uncertain pronunciation or silence.
The generic alignment review gate withholds some implausible vowel-to-consonant assignments, but it is not a complete human review of source alignments.

edgeCases.concern: AH0 schwa should have sourced quick cue, not inherited stressed AH stretch.
Letter name IY1 is stretch; spelling alone does not identify schwa.
Letter-name pronunciation needs an alignment; it is not the /ks/ sound of x in box.
The x group must retain two independently cued phones K quick and S stretch.
Final silent e participates in the reviewed generic split-digraph pattern.
Y+UW multi-phone alignment must retain both phones.
Risky upstream vowel-to-p assignment is withheld, not silently repaired.
Risky source vowel-to-consonant assignment requires review.
Risky source vowel-to-consonant assignment requires review.
Heteronym: context-free primary pronunciation cannot choose tense.
Primary and reduced/dialect alternatives are not contextually selected.
Irregular spelling must follow source pronunciation.
Irregular spelling alignment must retain source phone order.
Vowel team is not automatically long.
One EY phoneme crosses the raw a/y source boundary.
One EY phoneme crosses the raw a/i source boundary.
Source a participates in CH; questionable ownership remains withheld.
Conflicting ie and er teaching units must not both claim the same silent span.
